name: Magic Missile
description: 1st-level evocation, range 120 feet. Three glowing darts of force strike unerringly, each for 1d4 + 1 force damage. No attack roll and no save. This pack sends all three darts at one target; splitting darts between creatures and casting with higher-level slots are handled at the table. Costs one 1st-level spell slot.

effects.text: Three darts of force from {source.name} strike {target.name}.
